- The living bond: downloads now rebalance across your bonded network adapters
  while they run. Every new connection goes to the link that is actually
  fastest *for one connection* (measured on your machine, not assumed), so a
  fast phone tether + slower Wi-Fi load the tether first instead of splitting
  traffic by whoever got a head start.
- A network adapter that dies mid-download no longer freezes the task: dead
  connections are detected and retried on the surviving links (about 30 s
  worst case), the adapter is dropped from the pool on the next scan, and it
  is adopted back the moment it returns. No restart, no lost bytes.
- The end of a download no longer crawls: a worker that finishes early steals
  the tail of the largest remaining chunk instead of idling.
- GUI: the status bar shows a live chip per bonded adapter (current speed,
  active connections). Settings > Network grew per-adapter cards with a
  checkbox to include or exclude each adapter from bonding
  (`ripdl config bond_exclude=Adapter1,...` from the CLI).
- New About page.
